units.headline: OpenAPI cache-hit test uses two-step circuit breaker

units.summary: routerMetrics gains a longRunning gauge vec for watches and its doc comment is updated. The struct is internal but the new field backs a new exported metric.
units.headline: Router metrics struct gains long-running watch gauge
units.reason: Adds an internal field backing a new metric; behavior is exercised in instrument and newRouterMetrics.

units.summary: Watches are now counted in a per-group long-running gauge and excluded from the in-flight gauge and duration histogram. The histogram gains a verb label, changing the metric schema for dashboards and alerts.
units.headline: Watches tracked in separate gauge; histogram gains verb label
units.reason: Changes metric label schema and request accounting, plus a new deferred logging path for watches.
focus: dashboards or alerts that depend on the status_code-only histogram labels
watch access log still emitted on panic or abort

units.summary: Adds a router-wide watches context and cancel func used to end all watches on shutdown. Wiring is in NewGrafanaRouter and closeWatches.
units.headline: Router gains a context to end all watches on close
units.reason: New lifecycle state affecting request cancellation and shutdown behavior.
focus: endWatches is called on every stop path
routers constructed without NewGrafanaRouter leave watches nil safely

units.summary: Routed requests now reject Upgrade requests with 400 and send watch requests through serveWatch, which scopes them to the backend entry's lifetime. Ordinary requests are unchanged.
units.headline: Routed watches get lifetime scope; upgrades rejected with 400
units.reason: Changes request handling, cancellation, and rejects a class of requests that previously proxied.
focus: clients relying on WebSocket upgrades to routed groups
watch ends on backend replacement and clients reconnect to the new entry
entry.watches captured from the snapshot matches the served handler

units.summary: The unregistered-group fallback now rejects upgrades with 400 and runs watches through serveWatch with no backend scope, so they end only on router shutdown.
units.headline: Fallback handler rejects upgrades and wraps watches
units.reason: Changes request handling and cancellation for the single-tenant fallback path.
focus: fallback upgrade rejection breaks any existing standalone upgrade use
watch panic recovery interacts with the fallback proxy

units.summary: New file adds verb detection via the apiserver RequestInfoFactory, upgrade rejection, and serveWatch which cancels a watch when its scope or the router ends and swallows ErrAbortHandler when the router ended it. closeWatches cancels all router watches on shutdown.
units.headline: Adds watch lifecycle control, verb detection, and upgrade rejection
units.reason: New concurrency, cancellation and panic-recovery logic on the request path.
focus: recover only swallows ErrAbortHandler when the router, not the client, ended the watch
requestVerb fallback to the HTTP method for paths RequestInfoFactory cannot parse
AfterFunc stop functions run so no goroutine or context leaks
